ns2:course.label: Biology of Reproduction
ns2:course.description: Study of the basic principles of reproduction, lactation, growth, and hormone regulation of domestic and non-domestic animals as well as humans, including biotechnological methods of reproductive control, manipulation, performance enhancement of lactation and growth, and disease control. Same as IB 331. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing; IB 104 or one introductory level biology course.
